description: Our project is an interactive website inspired by a jukebox, allowing users to explore and listen to the sounds of planet Earth. From wildlife and oceans to natural environments and atmospheric phenomena, the website transforms Earth's sounds into a unique experience, combining technology, science, and nature while encouraging people to discover, appreciate, and connect with our planet through sound. It also highlights Earth's diversity and the importance of protecting our environment.

ECOBEATS – EARTH JUKEBOX 3D

Listen to Our Planet. Discover Earth Through Music.

EcoBeats – Earth Jukebox 3D is an interactive web experience that transforms Earth's environmental and climate information into a dynamic symphonic musical experience. Inspired by the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, The Earth Information Jukebox, the project explores an innovative way to connect science, technology, music, and environmental awareness by allowing people to not only see our planet's changes but also hear them.

At the heart of EcoBeats is an interactive 3D representation of Earth, designed as a digital planetary instrument. Users can explore the globe, observe environmental indicators, and experience how different regions and natural phenomena can be translated into musical elements.

HOW THE INTERFACE WORKS

The interface features a rotating 3D Earth with environmental visualization layers representing important planetary processes, including temperature variations, atmospheric conditions, winds, ocean currents, vegetation, and biomass indicators.

A vertical scanning line moves across the rotating planet, progressively reading the visual indicators and creating a continuous connection between the geographical information and the musical composition. As users select different regions or environmental layers, the musical experience changes, reflecting the characteristics and variations represented by the selected data.

FROM SCIENTIFIC DATA TO SYMPHONIC MUSIC

EcoBeats uses the concept of data sonification: translating scientific information into sound through musical parameters.

Environmental variables can influence different musical characteristics, such as:

  • Temperature: influences musical pitch and tonal variation.
  • Wind and atmospheric movement: inspires dynamic textures and rhythmic patterns.
  • Ocean currents: influences rhythmic sequences and melodic movement.
  • Vegetation and biomass: contributes to harmonic layers and musical density.
  • Environmental variations: create changes in intensity, rhythm, and orchestral composition.

The result is an evolving instrumental soundtrack inspired by the complexity and interconnectedness of Earth's natural systems.

The musical experience is designed around a symphonic orchestral aesthetic, transforming environmental information into an engaging and emotionally meaningful listening experience rather than presenting scientific data exclusively through charts and numerical indicators.

INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCE

The platform combines visual exploration and audio interaction through an intuitive interface featuring:

  • Interactive 3D planetary navigation.
  • Environmental visualization layers.
  • Selection of geographical regions and environmental indicators.
  • Dynamic musical changes associated with the selected information.
  • Play, pause, and stop controls.
  • A visual audio experience that connects sound and planetary information.

This approach encourages users to explore the planet actively, discover environmental patterns, and understand how different Earth systems interact.

SCIENTIFIC FOUNDATION AND NASA DATA

The project is inspired by NASA's Earth Information Center (EIC) visualizations and the scientific resources made available through NASA's Earth observation programs.

Its proposed data framework includes environmental information related to surface temperature, atmospheric processes, ocean dynamics, vegetation, biomass, and other indicators of planetary change.

By connecting scientific visualization with musical interpretation, EcoBeats offers a new way to communicate the value of Earth observation data and encourage curiosity about our planet.

INNOVATION, ACCESSIBILITY, AND IMPACT

One of EcoBeats' central ideas is that scientific information can be experienced through more than one sense. By combining visual and auditory representations, the project explores opportunities to make Earth science more engaging and potentially more accessible to people with different ways of perceiving and interacting with information.

Beyond its technological approach, EcoBeats aims to inspire environmental awareness. It transforms abstract scientific indicators into an experience that can be explored, heard, and remembered.

OUR VISION

What if we could listen to the Earth?

What if rising temperatures, moving ocean currents, changing vegetation, and atmospheric dynamics could become part of a musical composition?

EcoBeats turns this question into an interactive experience, connecting planetary science and artistic expression.

Our goal is to transform Earth's scientific information into a living symphony — where every region, every environmental signal, and every planetary change can contribute to a new way of understanding our world.

EcoBeats – Listen to Our Planet. Science has a sound.
